title: Course theme
description: Color overrides for the course site and its slide decks. Every key is optional; anything left out uses the package default. See docs/tokens.md.

surface.description: Raised or alternate surface: cards, table headers, code. CSS: --color-surface

surface-accent.description: Accent-tinted wash, light enough for muted and accent text to stay at 7:1. CSS: --color-surface-accent

surface-accent-secondary.description: Wayfinding wash: today, the current week. CSS: --color-surface-accent-secondary

accent.description: Brand color: fills, buttons, rules, the masthead wash. CSS: --color-accent

accent-text.description: Brand color for type, dark enough to read. CSS: --color-accent-text

accent-strong.description: Brand color for decorative marks: the text tone in light mode, the fill in dark. CSS: --color-accent-strong

on-accent.description: Text on a brand-color fill. CSS: --color-on-accent

accent-fill-hover.description: Solid brand fill, hovered, under on-accent text. CSS: --color-accent-fill-hover

accent-secondary.description: Wayfinding color: progress, section bars, the current location, highlighted code. CSS: --color-accent-secondary

on-accent-secondary.description: Text on a wayfinding-color fill. CSS: --color-on-accent-secondary

on-success.description: Text on a success fill. CSS: --color-on-success

on-error.description: Text on an error fill. CSS: --color-on-error

on-warning.description: Text on a warning fill. CSS: --color-on-warning

on-highlight.description: Text on a highlight fill. CSS: --color-on-highlight

border-strong.description: Edges of anything operable (at least 3:1). CSS: --color-border-strong

tag-test.description: Glossary tag hue for tests; its tints derive from it. CSS: --color-tag-test

tag-reading.description: Glossary tag hue for readings; its tints derive from it. CSS: --color-tag-reading

tag-meeting.description: Glossary tag hue for class meetings; its tints derive from it. CSS: --color-tag-meeting

code.description: Preformatted code text and its border. CSS: --color-code

code-keyword.description: Code keywords, and the copy button. CSS: --color-code-keyword

code-edge-neutral.description: Decorative language bar: anything else. CSS: --color-code-edge-neutral

gradient.description: One to four colors for decorative gradients. CSS: --color-gradient-1 to -4, joined as --gradient-stops
